title: SocialMemBench: Are AI Memory Systems Ready for Social Group Settings?
abstract: arXiv:2605.17789v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Memory systems for AI assistants were built for single-user dialogue, a design mismatched to multi-party social group settings. This matters for the social assistants being built today: group-acting agents in chat platforms, and proactive personal assistants whose model of a user must include their social context. Existing memory benchmarks evaluate dyadic or workplace dialogue; none targets social groups, where memory must anchor facts in shared history rather than professional roles, separate group norms from individual exceptions, and attribute correctly even after a member leaves.   We introduce SocialMemBench, a benchmark of human-verified synthetic social group networks across five archetypes and three size tiers (4-30 members), with 430 personas and 1,031 QA pairs across nine question categories. Our evaluation exposes five failure modes, framed as testable hypotheses, and we provide evidence on two through the research

translated_title: SocialMemBench：AI记忆系统是否已为社交群体场景做好准备？
translated_abstract: 面向AI助手的记忆系统是为单用户对话设计的，这一设计与多方社交群体场景并不匹配。这对当今正在构建的社交助手至关重要：聊天平台中以群体方式运作的智能体，以及主动式个人助手——其对用户的建模必须包含用户的社交背景。现有的记忆基准评估的是双人对话或职场对话；没有针对社交群体的基准，而在社交群体中，记忆必须将事实锚定于共享历史而非职业角色，区分群体规范与个体例外，并且在成员离开后仍能正确归属信息。我们提出了SocialMemBench，这是一个经人工验证的合成社交群体网络基准，涵盖五种群体原型和三种规模层级（4-30名成员），包含430个人设和1,031个问答对，分布于九个问题类别。我们的评估揭示了五种失败模式，并将其表述为可检验的假设，同时我们通过研究为其中两种提供了证据。
tldr: 提出了首个针对社交群体场景的AI记忆系统基准SocialMemBench，通过430个人设和1,031个问答对构成的合成社交网络，揭示了现有记忆系统在群体对话中的五种失败模式。
en_tdlr: Introduces SocialMemBench, the first benchmark for AI memory systems in social group settings, which uses 430 personas and 1,031 QA pairs across synthetic social networks to expose five failure modes of existing memory systems in multi-party contexts.
